questions.question: When streaming tool use, what does the input_json event's partial_json property carry?
options: A fragment of the tool call's arguments as they're generated
The full cumulative JSON assembled so far

questions.question: By default, why does streaming a tool call's arguments feel laggy (long pauses, then a sudden burst of text) rather than smooth?
options: The API buffers generated JSON and validates it against the tool's schema one top-level key at a time before releasing it
The network connection throttles tool_use events specifically
Claude generates tool arguments slower than regular text
Streaming is disabled by default for any request containing tools

questions.question: Passing fine_grained=True disables API-side JSON schema validation during streaming to get smoother output. What's the trade-off?
options: Your own code must now handle the possibility of receiving invalid JSON, since the API no longer guarantees well-formed output before delivery
It doubles the number of API calls required per tool use
It disables tool use entirely for that request
It requires switching to a different model
